viscript_npc.ai.info.title: Node Information
viscript_npc.ai.info.connections.root: Connect the output to one top-level child. The entry has no parent. Place nodes freely.
viscript_npc.ai.info.connections.branch: Connect the input to a parent and the output to two children. Assign true and false branches in Child order; positions do not affect the decision.
viscript_npc.ai.info.connections.leaf: Connect the input to a parent. Has no ordinary child-flow output. Parameter ports accept variables; events such as On hit use separate ports.
viscript_npc.ai.info.connections.single: Connect the input to a parent and the output to one child. Place nodes freely.
viscript_npc.ai.info.connections.ordered: Connect the input to a parent and the output to multiple children. Set execution order or priority in Child order; canvas positions do not change logic.
viscript_npc.ai.description.root: The single entry point of a behavior tree or reusable action.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.root: Runs the connected child and returns its result. Each graph must have exactly one entry.
viscript_npc.ai.description.sequence: Executes children in their saved order.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.sequence: Continues on success, stops on failure and waits on running. Resumes the running child next tick without repeating earlier successful checks. Succeeds when all children succeed. Use Reactive Sequence to recheck conditions.
viscript_npc.ai.description.selector: Tries children in saved priority order.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.selector: Tries the next child on failure; stops on success or running. Remembers the running child without preemption. Use Reactive Selector to recheck higher priorities.
viscript_npc.ai.description.cooldown: Limits how often a behavior branch can start, such as a special attack every few seconds.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.cooldown: Starts its cooldown after the child finishes, whether successfully or unsuccessfully. Returns failure while cooling down so a selector can try another branch. Duration is in seconds.
viscript_npc.ai.description.timeout: Sets a maximum duration for a child, preventing waits or movement from running indefinitely.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.timeout: Returns the child's result within the duration. Cancels the child and returns failure when the time limit is exceeded. The duration is in seconds.
viscript_npc.ai.description.invert: Reverses a child's success and failure results to express a negative condition.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.invert: Success becomes failure and failure becomes success; running stays running. Does not undo effects already produced by the child.
viscript_npc.ai.description.repeat: Repeats a child a finite number of times, such as performing three attacks.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.repeat: Restarts after each successful iteration and succeeds at the requested count. Any failed iteration stops the loop with failure. Runs at least once.
viscript_npc.ai.description.call: Reference an independent action file to compose reusable attacks, pursuit, idle and other sequences in a tree or another action.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.call: Choose an action file, then bind its target and exposed inputs. Inherit defaults or bind values from the caller inputs, locals and NPC blackboard. Wait for the child result; cancellation propagates into the child. Double-click to open the action project.
viscript_npc.ai.description.stage: Groups actions into a named stage such as windup, airborne, impact or recovery. The stage name appears in debugging.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.stage: Runs children in order and fails on a failed child. Disabling interruption prevents conditions and higher-priority branches from preempting it. Explicit stop and timeout can still cancel it.
viscript_npc.ai.description.branch: Chooses one of two branches using a boolean value, including a bound variable.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.branch: Evaluates once on entry: true runs the first child, false runs the second. Runs only the chosen branch and returns its result.
viscript_npc.ai.description.wait: Pauses this flow for a duration to control attack intervals, windup and recovery.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.wait: Keeps running until the duration in seconds has elapsed, then succeeds. Does not stop other NPCs or block the server thread.
viscript_npc.ai.description.wait_ground: Waits for the NPC to land, usually after Jump to Landing Point and before impact or recovery.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.wait_ground: Succeeds on landing. If a previous jump supplied an expected landing point, also checks proximity to it. Fails on excessive landing error or when the timeout in seconds expires.
viscript_npc.ai.description.find_target: Finds the nearest valid target in a radius, a forward sector, or both, and can store its entity reference.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.find_target: The proximity volume is a cylinder; the rectangular view follows horizontal head rotation. Height extends equally above and below the NPC feet. Optionally checks block occlusion. Succeeds with a target; otherwise clears its output and fails.
viscript_npc.ai.description.set_target: Sets the current target from an entity UUID supplied directly or through a variable.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.set_target: The entity must be in the current dimension and pass target and faction checks. Fails for an invalid UUID, missing entity or disallowed target.
viscript_npc.ai.description.clear_target: Clears the NPC's current target when leaving combat or returning to idle.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.clear_target: Immediately clears the target and succeeds. Add Stop Navigation as well when movement should stop.
viscript_npc.ai.description.position: Computes a position from the NPC, its target or fixed coordinates and stores it in a local position variable.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.position: Offsets are in blocks. Forward and right follow the reference facing; fixed coordinates use the NPC facing. Target origin requires a target. Declare the local output variable with Position type first.
viscript_npc.ai.description.navigate: Navigates the NPC to a position, which can be supplied by a position variable.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.navigate: Succeeds within the arrival range, keeps running while calculating or moving, and fails on timeout or no usable path. Currently accepts goals within 48 blocks and uses loaded chunks only.
viscript_npc.ai.description.approach: Pursues the current target until within the requested distance, often before a melee attack.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.approach: Speed directly sets the movement speed attribute, default 0.5. Range is in blocks, and time is a timeout in seconds. Updates the path when the target moves significantly. Fails without a target, on navigation failure or timeout.
viscript_npc.ai.description.stop: Cancels the NPC's active path calculation and path following.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.stop: Immediately cancels navigation and succeeds. Does not clear the target or end the remaining action flow.
viscript_npc.ai.description.look: Turns the NPC toward its current target before attacking or playing an action.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.look: Requests a turn and succeeds with a valid target; fails without one. The look controller performs the turn progressively.
viscript_npc.ai.description.jump: Starts a jump toward a landing point, such as a gap crossing or leap attack. Can use a computed position.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.jump: Succeeds when the jump starts, without waiting for landing. Add Wait for Landing before impact effects. Fails if out of range, obstructed or jumping is disallowed.
viscript_npc.ai.description.melee: Attempts one melee hit on the current target using damage, range and knockback settings.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.melee: The target must pass attack checks including range, sight and factions. Succeeds only on a hit. Does not pursue or wait for cooldown automatically; combine it with pursuit and wait nodes. The on-hit branch starts only after accepted damage, with a separate context for each hit entity. The main flow continues.
viscript_npc.ai.description.ranged: Fires one projectile at the current target using damage, range, projectile speed and item settings.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.ranged: Succeeds after target and attack checks pass and the projectile is fired. The projectile may not have hit yet. Use wait or repeat nodes to schedule repeated shots. The on-hit branch starts only after accepted damage, with a separate context for each hit entity. The main flow continues.
viscript_npc.ai.description.area_damage: Deals damage and knockback around the NPC, suitable for landing impacts or area attacks.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.area_damage: Range is in blocks. Respects factions and line of sight. Succeeds after one area check even when no eligible entity is hit. The on-hit branch starts only after accepted damage, with a separate context for each hit entity. The main flow continues.
viscript_npc.ai.description.knockback: Pushes the current target away from the NPC, independently of damage.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.knockback: Strength controls the push. Succeeds with an eligible target and fails otherwise. This node does not deal damage.
viscript_npc.ai.description.effect: Applies a status effect such as Slowness or Weakness to the current target.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.effect: Choose the effect, duration in seconds and amplifier. Amplifier 0 means level I. Respects faction attack rules and fails without an eligible target or valid effect.
viscript_npc.ai.description.swing: Plays the NPC's main-hand swing for attack windup or impact animation.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.swing: Immediately swings and succeeds. Animation only; add a melee or area damage node to deal damage.
viscript_npc.ai.description.particle: Spawns particles around the NPC for windup cues, hit feedback or landing effects.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.particle: Choose particle type, count and spread in blocks. Succeeds after one emission and fails on an invalid resource. Particles do not deal damage.
viscript_npc.ai.description.sound: Plays a sound at the NPC for an attack, windup or landing.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.sound: Choose a sound resource, volume and pitch. Succeeds after starting playback and fails on an invalid resource. Does not wait for playback to finish.
viscript_npc.ai.description.set_variable: Writes a declared local or NPC Blackboard variable for later nodes to read.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.set_variable: Choose the scope, variable and a value or binding of the same type. Locals belong to the current action execution; Blackboard values are shared by this NPC's behaviors. Succeeds immediately after assignment.
viscript_npc.ai.description.success: A leaf that immediately returns success.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.success: Only returns a node status; its parent decides what runs next. Can be inverted or repeated. Does not exit the whole behavior.
viscript_npc.ai.description.failure: A leaf that immediately returns failure.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.failure: Only returns a node status. A selector may try its next child, and an inverter converts it to success.
Optional language-file key used in the action library and file search. Shows the file path when blank or untranslated.
viscript_npc.ai.tip.action_info: Action information · Set name translation key
viscript_npc.ai.description.get_entity: Stores self, the current target, the hit entity, or another entity reference in an entity variable.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.get_entity: Clears the output and fails if the entity is dead, unloaded, or in another dimension. Keeps the NPC target.
viscript_npc.ai.description.entity_info: Reads health, maximum health, health ratio, alive state, position, or entity type ID from the selected entity.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.entity_info: The output variable must match the selected property type. Invalid references return false for alive; other properties clear the output and fail.

viscript_npc.ai.tip.mob_filter: Used only when the target filter is attackable mobs.
viscript_npc.ai.tip.open_or_drag_example: Click to open the official example project; drag into the blueprint to call this action
viscript_npc.ai.library.empty: No action function files on the server
viscript_npc.ai.description.sense_target: Continuously detects targets while its child runs, allowing guards to switch between patrol and combat.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.sense_targets: A perception decorator that periodically updates the current target before ticking its subtree, clearing the target when none is found. Propagates the subtree status. Combine with Reactive Selector and Target Exists for combat and patrol.
viscript_npc.ai.description.patrol: Moves to random standable positions around the patrol center fixed when execution starts.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.patrol: Selects one patrol point and pauses on arrival. Cancels movement when interrupted by combat. Returns to the center first when outside the patrol area.
viscript_npc.ai.tip.view_radius: Maximum horizontal distance of the vision sector, from 0 to 64 blocks. Set to 0 to disable sector detection.
viscript_npc.ai.tip.view_angle: Full opening angle from 0 to 360 degrees. 90 means 45 degrees on each side; 360 covers all directions. 0 disables sector detection.
viscript_npc.ai.tree_example.guard: Melee guard: patrol, detect, chase and attack
viscript_npc.ai.tree_example.ranged_guar: Ranged guard: patrol, detect, chase and shoot
viscript_npc.ai.tip.tree_example: Creates a separate NPC project with a complete behavior tree. Reusable actions are available in the action library.
viscript_npc.ai.debug.perception: Perception: orange = proximity, yellow = forward view, blue = path. Outlines show geometry; targets must also pass type, faction and occlusion checks.
viscript_npc.ai.tip.variable_display_nam: Optional language key for call parameters and ports. Falls back to the internal variable name when blank or untranslated; bindings keep using the same variable ID.
viscript_npc.ai.tip.variable_tips_key: Optional language key explaining what this variable does. Shown when hovering a parameter, its help icon, or its port; omitted when blank or untranslated.
viscript_npc.ai.parameter.damage.tips: Damage dealt by each hit, before armor and other damage modifiers.
viscript_npc.ai.parameter.attack_interva: Time to wait after an attack, in seconds. A smaller value starts the next attack sooner.
viscript_npc.ai.parameter.speed.tips: Directly sets the movement speed attribute for this movement, default 0.5. Higher values move faster. This is not a multiplier or a value in blocks per second.
viscript_npc.ai.parameter.range.tips: Distance from the target at which the NPC may stop approaching, in blocks.
viscript_npc.ai.parameter.landing.tips: Position recorded near the target, used as the destination of the jump.
Range used to choose a random patrol destination, in blocks.
Radius of the area damage on landing, in blocks.
viscript_npc.ai.description.detect_targe: Checks for a matching entity in the range circle, view sector or their union.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.detect_target: Succeeds if an entity is detected, otherwise fails. This condition leaf never changes the current target. Use Find Target to acquire an entity, or Continuous Perception to keep the target updated.
viscript_npc.ai.description.target_exist: Checks that the current target is alive and in the same dimension.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.target_exists: Succeeds if valid, otherwise fails. Does not search or implicitly check distance or visibility. Connect alongside actions under a sequence.
viscript_npc.ai.description.target_dista: Checks the current target distance against an inclusive interval.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.target_distance: Succeeds for a valid target within the minimum and maximum distances, otherwise fails. Does not check field of view or occlusion.
viscript_npc.ai.node.target_sight: Clear line of sight to target
viscript_npc.ai.description.target_sight: Checks for an unobstructed line of sight to the current target.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.target_sight: Succeeds if the target is valid and unobstructed, otherwise fails. Does not check facing or view angle. Use Target Detected for a view sector.
viscript_npc.ai.description.self_health: Checks whether the NPC health ratio is at or below a threshold.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.self_health: Succeeds at or below the threshold, otherwise fails. 0.5 means at most 50% health. No target is required.
viscript_npc.ai.description.number_compa: Compares two constant or variable numbers.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.number_compare: Succeeds if the selected equality, less-than or greater-than relation holds, otherwise fails. No target or child is required.
viscript_npc.ai.description.reactive_seq: Rechecks from the first child each tick, for conditions followed by a running action.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.reactive_sequen: Continues on success; failure cancels later running children. Running preserves the selected child. Earlier conditions and actions run again each tick. Uninterruptible stages complete to their boundary before reevaluation.
viscript_npc.ai.description.reactive_sel: Reevaluates children from highest priority each tick.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.reactive_select: Tries the next child on failure and selects success or running. A higher priority branch cancels a running lower priority branch. Uninterruptible stages finish to their boundary first.
viscript_npc.ai.description.parallel: Advances multiple children each tick without rerunning completed children.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.parallel: All: fails on any failure, succeeds when all succeed. Any: succeeds on any success, fails when all fail. Otherwise returns running. Completion cancels running siblings. If multiple movement actions compete, newer navigation takes control and the displaced action fails.
viscript_npc.ai.description.until_succes: Repeats its child until the child succeeds.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.until_success: Waits while running, restarts after failure on the next tick, and succeeds on success. Starts at most one iteration per tick. Cancellation stops the current child.
viscript_npc.ai.description.until_failur: Repeats its child until the child fails.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.until_failure: Waits while running and restarts after success on the next tick. Returns success when the child fails and the loop completes. Starts at most one iteration per tick.
viscript_npc.ai.description.force_succes: Converts the child terminal result to success.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.force_success: Preserves running; returns success after either terminal child result. Explicit Finish Behavior nodes exit the behavior directly.
viscript_npc.ai.description.force_failur: Converts the child terminal result to failure.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.force_failure: Preserves running; returns failure after either terminal child result. Explicit Finish Behavior nodes exit the behavior directly.
viscript_npc.ai.description.finish_succe: Exits the current behavior early with success.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.finish_success: Returns to the calling node and bypasses decorators within this behavior. Use Return Success for an ordinary leaf result.
viscript_npc.ai.description.finish_failu: Exits the current behavior early with failure.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.finish_failure: Returns to the caller, allowing an outer selector to try another behavior. Use Return Failure for an ordinary leaf result.
viscript_npc.ai.reason.navigation_supers: Navigation taken over by another action
viscript_npc.ai.tip.step: Node step: advance one node execution position, then pause within the same AI tick
viscript_npc.ai.debug.breakpoint: Breakpoint: pause before executing this node
viscript_npc.ai.debug.breakpoint_hit: Breakpoint hit: resume or step to continue
viscript_npc.ai.debug.disconnected: Test a behavior and select an NPC first
viscript_npc.ai.description.debug_log: Write a message and input value to the test NPC debug log. Accepts behavior parameters and variables of any type.
viscript_npc.ai.description.debug_line: Draw a temporary segment between two world positions in the test scene.
viscript_npc.ai.description.debug_ray: Draw a temporary ray from a world position along a vector. The vector length controls its length.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.debug_log: Succeeds immediately. Records only in test debug sessions and does not change variables.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.debug_line: Succeeds immediately. Visible for the specified seconds of AI ticks, preserved while paused.
viscript_npc.ai.behavior.debug_ray: Succeeds immediately. Visible for the specified seconds of AI ticks, preserved while paused.
viscript_npc.ai.tip.scene_window: Show the test scene in a separate window
viscript_npc.editor.ai_test.window: Detach test scene / return to main window

viscript_npc.ai.save.no_matches: No loaded NPCs have marker "%s". Check the marker and load their chunks.
viscript_npc.ai.save.empty_marker: Set an NPC marker in Basic Settings before saving and applying AI.
viscript_npc.ai.save.no_permission: Saving and applying NPC AI requires operator permissions.
viscript_npc.ai.save.failed: AI could not be saved. NPCs keep their previous AI.
viscript_npc.ai.tip.step_tick: AI tick step: finish the current round, or advance one round, then pause
viscript_npc.ai.debug.before_node: This node will execute next; its current update has not run yet
viscript_npc.ai.debug.tick_complete: AI tick complete; the next step starts a new round
